_comment: Reviews shown on the home page. Paste in the ones you want featured from the
Google Business Profile, then rebuild.
WHY THIS IS A FILE AND NOT A LIVE FEED: Google's Places API returns at most
five reviews and its policy forbids caching review content, so a live feed
cannot show a curated selection from 68 reviews. Featuring them here gives
full control over which ones lead.
RULES THE BUILD ENFORCES:
- A review needs both 'author' and 'text'. A half-filled entry fails the
build rather than reaching the page.
- Text that looks like placeholder copy fails the build too. The site this
replaced shipped three invented testimonials attributed to named people;
that must not happen again.
- With no usable reviews, the section becomes a plain link to Google
instead of showing filler. Nothing is ever invented to fill space.
FIELDS:
author    as it appears on Google. First name and last initial is fine.
rating    1-5. Omit or null to hide the stars on that card.
date      'YYYY-MM' or 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Rendered as 'July 2026' - absolute,
so it never becomes wrong the way '3 months ago' does.
text      the review, verbatim. Do not edit a tenant's words.
response  your public reply, if there is one. Optional.
Three or six reads best - the desktop grid is three columns, so four or
five leaves an orphan on the last row. Nine is the most it handles cleanly.
profileUrl  full Google Maps URL for the profile (google.com/maps/place/...).
Avoid share.google short links - Google retired goo.gl in 2025.
reviewUrl   the 'Ask for reviews' link from Google Business Profile,
https://g.page/r/XXXXXXXX/review - opens the star dialog directly.
rating      your overall score, e.g. 4.8. Omit to hide the aggregate.
total       total review count, for 'Read all 68 on Google'.

reviews.author: Marquette Barnes
reviews.text: Daniel is the best!! He was very patient , considerate and patient in helping my daughter and I find the best home for our family!! I am new to the area and Daniel stepped in to assist with no hesitation!! If you want the best ask for Daniel!!!

reviews.author: Mac Nelson
reviews.text: Matt (repairs) has been so great to work with. He's making my rental maintenance smooth and easy, taking care of my rentals like they were his own. And on every issue fast. Making me feel like he doesn't have dozens of other owners to answer to. Matt is excellent to work with.
reviews.response: Thank you Mac for trusting in us!

reviews.author: Eve Renee
reviews.text: I had such an amazing experience with Yoak Properties! Especially Aaron, he is awesome! He did a great job with every step of the process of me moving into my new home! From the initial day of meeting him and touring the home (I knew it was gonna be my new place right away!), to the getting the keys and everything in between. Thank you Aaron!
reviews.response: Thanks for believing in Aaron and the team!

reviews.author: Emily AdC
reviews.text: I recently moved into a newly renovated property with Yoak. Harrison was great with communication and leasing amendments at the start. Within the last few days, I ran over a nail in my gravel driveway from them doing renovations. After explaining what happened, showing them photos of the nails, and the receipt for the repair for the tire, without question, they credited my account with the amount that was used to fix my tire. Not only happy with this quick problem solving but it was fair too. Thank you Amanda, Matt, and Harrison.

reviews.author: lil Bread
reviews.text: Moved in one month ago. Aaron helped us get the keys and was very quick to answer our questions anytime we reached out. He was very positive and knowledgeable. This was the easiest time I've ever had getting into a new house.
reviews.response: Glad we were able to make this a seamless process for you and the family!

reviews.author: David Richeson-Orr
reviews.text: Tommy from maintenance came and fixed the sealing for my doors so critters would stay out and fixed my sink because I happened to mention a leaky seal. Super nice guy and hope to see him again in the future for any other repairs.
reviews.response: Glad we could get it handled for u!
